title: Alembic 0001 reversible migration
description:
Create the initial Alembic migration at migrations/versions/0001_core_schema.py. This migration must create all six tables from chatbot/db/models.py — User, Session, Message, Episode, SemanticFact, Entity — with all columns, foreign keys, indexes, and the pgvector extension.

Requirements:
- The migration must enable the pgvector extension (CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector) in upgrade()
- The Message.embedding and SemanticFact.embedding columns must use sa.Vector(None) so the dimension is configurable at migration time
- downgrade() must drop all six tables and the pgvector extension (DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS vector), making the migration fully reversible
- Use Alembic's autogenerate as a starting point but verify the output matches the models exactly
- All foreign keys must cascade correctly: Session→User ON DELETE CASCADE, Message→Session ON DELETE CASCADE, etc.
- Indexes: User.external_id, Entity.name, Session.user_id, Message.session_id

Ensure the migrations/env.py is configured to import the Base metadata from chatbot.db.models and use the async engine from chatbot.db.session.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task c.4)
- chatbot/db/models.py (produced by task c.2)
- chatbot/db/session.py (produced by task c.1)
- migrations/env.py (if it exists)
- migrations/alembic.ini (if it exists)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: upgrade() creates all six tables with pgvector extension
downgrade() drops all six tables and the pgvector extension
Migration is reversible (upgrade then downgrade runs without error)
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
